SELECT * FROM ads_content_hot_rank
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
AND platform <> 'WEIBO'
AND publish_time IS NOT NULL
AND publish_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND publish_time < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY platform_heat_index DESC, hot_score DESC, publish_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ads_platform_category_heat
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
AND platform <> 'WEIBO'
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, platform ASC, category ASC

WITH hourly_category AS ( SELECT event_id, platform,
DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS time_bucket,
AS category,
COUNT(*) AS content_count,
ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(platform_heat_index, 0)), 2) AS average_relative_heat_index FROM ads_content_hot_rank
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
AND platform IN ('TENCENT_NEWS', 'NETEASE_NEWS', 'SOHU_NEWS', 'SINA_NEWS', 'THE_PAPER')
AND publish_time IS NOT NULL
AND NULLIF(TRIM(category), '') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY event_id, platform, DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), ), hourly_total AS (
SELECT event_id, platform, time_bucket, SUM(content_count) AS platform_content_count FROM hourly_category
GROUP BY event_id, platform, time_bucket )
SELECT category.event_id, category.platform, category.time_bucket, category.category,
category.content_count,
total.platform_content_count,
category.average_relative_heat_index FROM hourly_category category JOIN hourly_total total
ON total.event_id = category.event_id AND total.platform = category.platform AND total.time_bucket = category.time_bucket
ORDER BY category.time_bucket ASC, category.platform ASC, category.category ASC

SELECT content_id, title, UPPER(TRIM(platform)) AS platform, author_name, publish_time, keywords, clean_text AS content_text, sentiment_label, sentiment_source, category, content_type, sentiment_positive_score, sentiment_neutral_score, sentiment_negative_score, hot_score, platform_heat_index, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count, repost_count, source_url FROM ads_content_hot_rank
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
AND UPPER(TRIM(platform)) IN ('WEIBO', 'SOHU_NEWS', 'TENCENT_NEWS', 'NETEASE_NEWS', 'SINA_NEWS', 'THE_PAPER')
AND sentiment_label IN ('positive', 'negative')
ORDER BY publish_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) topic_count FROM (
SELECT TRIM(title) topic FROM ads_content_hot_rank
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
AND TRIM(COALESCE(title, '')) <> ''
GROUP BY TRIM(title) ) topics

SELECT TRIM(title) topic,
COUNT(*) content_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT platform) platform_count,
MIN(publish_time) first_publish_time,
MAX(publish_time) latest_publish_time,
SUM(COALESCE(hot_score, 0)) hot_score FROM ads_content_hot_rank
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
AND TRIM(COALESCE(title, '')) <> ''
GROUP BY TRIM(title)
ORDER BY hot_score DESC, content_count DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM etl_batch
WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1
